==Update -- January 9, 2026==

* Fixed a bug where adding more than 19 purchased [[character slot]]s to an [[account]] returned an error (instead of the published limit of 26).
* Fixed a bug where the status of "dialog pinning" and "start menu dragging" options were reset every time a person re-logged.
